policy: Authored lessons, not parity fixtures. Review actual runtime frames and full playback before default promotion. Captured posters are generated by scripts/showcase-capture.mjs; never substitute illustrations or Manim renders. Exact-source references remain unchanged.

entries.title: Your first scene
entries.lesson: Create two objects, arrange them, and animate a composition.
entries.thumbnail_alt: The blue circle and pink square after their movement and completed emphasis pulse

entries.title: A field in motion
entries.lesson: Explore dense animation through six coordinated sequences: assembly, morphs, waves, a spiral, an object exchange, and a resolved finale.
entries.thumbnail_alt: The actual 600-shape field recomposing into a colorful spiral beside 24 animated labels

entries.title: Entrances and exits
entries.lesson: Compare four ways to reveal and remove the same shape, using a shared duration.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Four equal blue squares under Fade, Draw, Grow, and Spin labels after their different entrances

entries.title: Together, sequential, staggered
entries.lesson: Compare the same row of objects with three different timing arrangements.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Three labeled rows comparing simultaneous, sequential, and staggered entrances

entries.title: Animate part of a group
entries.lesson: Select existing members with a slice while the surrounding objects stay in place.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Five indexed objects with the three slice-selected members raised above their neighbors

entries.title: Bend a vector curve
entries.lesson: Construct a cubic Bezier curve from anchors and handles, then morph it while the anchors stay fixed.
entries.thumbnail_alt: A blue cubic curve between white anchors with yellow control handles and a gray control polygon

entries.title: Transform, replace, or copy
entries.lesson: See which source or target reference remains useful after each kind of morph.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Three labeled morph outcomes, with the copy retaining its original square and both source and target moving

entries.title: Match by shape
entries.lesson: Match vector geometry even when the target group's member order changes.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Kite and triangle in their reversed target arrangement after matching by geometry

entries.title: Accumulate or step through
entries.lesson: Compare accumulating group members with showing one member at a time.
entries.thumbnail_alt: An accumulated blue row above a single active pink member, with both behaviors labeled

entries.title: Words and equations
entries.lesson: Combine animated text, inline emphasis, and real typeset mathematics.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Styled words above a typeset summation identity, captured from Noon's text rendering

entries.title: Functions and samples
entries.lesson: Draw a function and illustrative sampled observations on common axes.
entries.thumbnail_alt: A blue function and yellow sampled observations drawn on shared axes with a color-matched legend

entries.title: Relationships that follow motion
entries.lesson: Drive two dots with ValueTrackers and keep their connector attached using public updaters.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Blue and teal dots at different heights joined by a yellow updater-driven connector and axis guides

entries.title: Pixels in the scene
entries.lesson: Reveal and animate a recognizable raster landscape without external assets.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Two actual array-backed landscape images at different sizes after a rotation and opacity sequence

entries.title: Select a shape
entries.lesson: Reveal a scene, then select a shape and clear the selection with a background click.
entries.thumbnail_alt: The actual blue circle selected beside the green rectangle after the animated introduction
entries.host_setup: The gallery enables pointer-fill-selection after source completion; copying the Python scene alone does not install pointer handling. See docs/gallery-curation.md.
